plan: Deep-copy inputs, resolve excluded ingredients through priority-ordered substitutions, support chained/additional ingredients, apply wording and equipment changes, then scale all rational quantities to the requested yield.
Aggregate substitution-cycle, missing-substitution, and unavailable-equipment reasons; preserve authored text unchanged and return deterministic sorted outputs.

trace.source_relation: Original recipes must remain printable exactly as authored and neither function may mutate inputs.
trace.target_mechanism: print_original returns authored_text directly, while adapt operates on a deep copy.

trace.source_relation: Quantities and yields use fractions.Fraction and scaling 3→5 must remain exact.
trace.target_mechanism: All quantity factors and yield scaling pass through a Fraction conversion helper.

trace.source_relation: Additional ingredients are subject to exclusions and substitutions, enabling chained adaptation.
trace.target_mechanism: New ingredients are appended to the same processing queue with substitution lineage tracking.

trace.source_relation: Lower numeric catalog priority wins, with catalog order as tie-breaker.
trace.target_mechanism: Catalog entries are stably ordered by priority and original index before selection.

trace.source_relation: Impossible results must include every independently applicable missing-substitution, equipment, and cycle reason.
trace.target_mechanism: Processing continues after failures and accumulates deduplicated reasons before sorting them.
